يقتتلوا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَتِلُوا (yaqtatilū) /jaq.ta.ti.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# يُقْتَتَلُوا (yuqtatalū) /juq.ta.ta.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
